title: GTA 6 PC Port Could Arrive Within Three Months of Console Launch
description: GameSpot reports that Rockstar Games may release Grand Theft Auto 6 on PC in early 2027, just a few months after its planned November 2026 console debut.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 PC Release Could Come Just Months After Consoles
socialHook: GTA 6 may hit PC within three months of its console launch, according to sources.

sections.heading: Report Details
paragraphs: GameSpot, citing a GamesBeat report, says industry sources claim Rockstar Games plans to launch Grand Theft Auto 6 on PC within the first three months of 2027. The game is expected to debut on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in November 2026.

The sources described the PC release as occurring just a few months after the console launch, which would be a departure from previous Rockstar titles that often waited over a year before arriving on PC.

sections.heading: Context and Unknowns
paragraphs: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick previously noted that PC is becoming a more important platform for the company, and Rockstar has not officially confirmed a PC version of GTA 6.
It remains unclear whether the reported timeline is final, and no official announcement has been made by Rockstar or Take-Two.
